pages.text: If you crouch and use chalk on an empty item focus, a screen will open where you can inscribe custom text in the circle (visible in the Sight). If the circle influences an action in a contract, it can specify exact quantities or ranges that the mob must put or take.

Just writing a number makes the contract require exactly that number. Writing <[number] or >[number] permits any lower or any higher number. Writing [number]-[number] permits a specific range (inclusive).
